header: This is the "What to type" page of the user guide: each feature of the search bar's tools by name, and beside it the words that open it, the alternatives separated by a front slash. Click any alternative to put it in the search bar (the reader still presses Enter where a page needs it). The list is data (src/lib/help/quickReference.ts, tested against the real detector); I write nothing about a feature here.
